title: Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport for Finite-Particle Diffusion Steering
description: A diffusion steering update can fit a small particle population almost perfectly and still fail on fresh samples. RCPT estimates how much of that update to keep, using the particles already in memory.

title: SurfSpec: Enhancing Off-Target-Agnostic Specificity by Bounding Pocket-Ligand Geometric Mismatch
description: Growing a ligand into unoccupied regions of its target pocket improves average docking-based specificity on CrossDocked2020, with off-target pockets used only for evaluation.

title: HybridLinker: Topology-Guided Posterior Sampling for Enhanced Diversity and Validity in 3D Molecular Linker Generation
description: A model that proposes diverse bonding patterns and a model that checks their 3D fit can together generate a wider range of valid linkers for the same two fragments.

title: SPAW Romantic Relationship Test
description: A bilingual relationship-style assessment using topological data analysis of MIMARA and ROCI-II responses.
